entries.reason: the function is carried for what it answers on a device with no Metal driver: iOS 6 runs on the A4 and A5, whose graphics have none, so there is no device to give
entries.effect: answers nil, as the framework does when the list of devices it keeps is empty; an application that falls back to OpenGL ES when it is given no device does so
entries.source: Metal of the arm64 shared cache of iOS 12.0, _MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice at 0x183053fa8, which runs once a routine at 0x183054090 that fills the list of devices and answers the first of the list
